helpPlatform: Credential fields adapt to the selected platform; most are review-free with self-serve credentials
helpHandle: Full Bluesky handle, see it in account settings
appPasswordEditPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep current credentials
helpAppPasswordCreate: Generate in bsky.app → Settings → App Passwords; verified and encrypted on save
helpAppPasswordEdit: Fill only to rotate credentials; secrets are encrypted and never echoed back
helpIsEnabled: Disabled accounts are excluded from new publishes
deleteAccountConfirmDesc: Unfinished distributions using this account will be blocked from deletion first
helpSourcePost: The content source of truth stays in CMS; only the distribution link is stored here
title: Article Title
helpTitle: Defaults to the linked post title when left empty
overrideTextPlaceholder: Text to publish (adapted from the post summary)
helpOverrideText: Per-platform override text, max {{max}} chars; immutable after publishing
helpPublishTime: Executed by the backend publish engine at the scheduled time; rescheduling re-queues
deleteDistributionConfirmDesc: Deleting does not affect published content on the platform
calendarHint: Click a date to create a distribution; markers show scheduled times

helpCred.chat_id: Channel ID (@channelname or -100…); the bot must be a channel admin
helpCred.thumb_media_id: Upload a cover image as permanent material in the WeChat backend and put its media_id here (required for publishing)
helpCred.app_secret: Official account AppSecret; server IP must be whitelisted
helpCred.private_key: 64-char hex or nsec (stored locally, keep it safe)
helpCred.rpc_url: e.g. cnblogs https://rpc.cnblogs.com/metaweblog/{blog}; enable MetaWeblog/API access in the blog backend

trendNoData: Not enough snapshots yet (auto pull every 30 minutes, or refresh manually to accumulate)
trendHint: Trend is based on pull history snapshots; one data point accumulates every 30 minutes after publishing
